decision: NO-GO — PostgreSQL remains the default financial engine.

summary.explanation: Artifact integrity and historical-key verification are deterministic repository invariants and pass with repository proof. Operational gates still require staging-real or production-real evidence, so two local passes cannot authorize activation.

commands: deno fmt --check apps packages tooling tests db deno.json sgconfig.yml vitest.config.ts
deno lint apps packages tooling tests vitest.config.ts
observations.outcome: Type checking, formatting, linting, package boundaries, 186 contract tests, and 195 full-suite tests passed.
observations.limits: Repository validation proves deterministic code behavior only; it does not prove deployment topology, operator response, provider custody, or production data recovery.

observations.outcome: The API reached the listening state on http://0.0.0.0:8000 after exact import-map aliases were added for the pinned Effect beta.103 Deno adapter dependencies.
observations.limits: This proves local process startup, not a financial operation, process-kill recovery, staging routing, or production-equivalent supervision.

observations.outcome: The worker now passes Effect module loading and reaches PostgreSQL, then fails because the selected local database does not contain process.jobs.
observations.limits: A migrated disposable database and a real financial job are still required before worker lease/restart behavior can be rehearsed.

commands: kill -TERM <tigerbeetle-pid>; restart the same replica; rerun the integration test
observations.outcome: A real one-replica TigerBeetle development process passed adapter integration before and after SIGTERM and restart.
observations.limits: One development replica has no quorum-loss, state-sync, supervisor, production credentials, or economic-cohort semantics.

observations.outcome: A PostgreSQL 19beta3 dump restored into an independent local database.
observations.limits: The source did not contain a production-equivalent cohort and no corresponding TigerBeetle restore or cross-store comparison was performed.

observations.outcome: A signed artifact created with an old key remains verifiable and approvable after the active signer rotates, provided the historical verifier remains in the keyring.
observations.limits: This proves key-ID resolution semantics, not KMS/HSM custody, provider audit logs, revocation policy, or emergency recovery.

gates.title: Controlled activation cannot be bypassed
gates.reason: FAIL for release: PostgreSQL constraints and service authorization reject direct activation in tests, but the complete deployed prepare/approve/activate path has not been exercised with real runtime roles and credentials.
gates.requiredEvidence: A staging rehearsal showing authorized prepare, independently produced evidence, separate approval, activation, and rejection of direct database or legacy-route bypass attempts.
gates.remediation: Run the bounded staging cohort with distinct principals and capture database audit rows, capability decisions, artifact IDs, and the final engine state.

gates.title: Real process kill cannot create economic double-posting
gates.reason: FAIL: fault injection proves retry logic at code seams, but no operating-system kill occurred after a real TigerBeetle acceptance while a real worker owned the durable job.
gates.requiredEvidence: A migrated staging database, real worker process, real TigerBeetle transfer, kill at the accepted-before-finalized boundary, restart, and proof of one economic transfer set and one finalized projection.
gates.remediation: Build and run a subprocess rehearsal that records operation ID, transfer IDs, lease token, kill timestamp, restart timestamp, and post-recovery reconciliation result.

gates.title: Worker and adapter restart is deterministic
gates.reason: FAIL: Effect import resolution is fixed, but the local worker stops at a missing process.jobs table; no leased financial job survived worker termination and lease expiry.
gates.requiredEvidence: A fully migrated disposable or staging database plus two real worker processes demonstrating stale-lease rejection and successful reacquisition after expiry.
gates.remediation: Migrate the rehearsal database, enqueue one financial operation job, kill worker A while leased, wait for expiry, start worker B, and verify fenced completion.

gates.title: TigerBeetle outage fails closed
gates.reason: FAIL for release: mock and adapter tests show no PostgreSQL fallback, but no real network/process outage measured unknown outcomes, retry timing, recovery, and final reconciliation.
gates.requiredEvidence: A real TigerBeetle outage during submission proving no PostgreSQL financial acceptance, bounded retry behavior, restored connectivity, and same-ID reconciliation.
gates.remediation: Inject a staging network or process outage and retain operation, transfer, journal, retry, latency, and reconciliation evidence.

gates.title: Replica and quorum failure behavior is proven
gates.reason: FAIL: the only real TigerBeetle run used one development replica, so quorum loss, view change, replica state synchronization, and recovery were impossible to observe.
gates.requiredEvidence: A version-pinned production-equivalent multi-replica cluster with controlled replica loss, quorum loss, restart, state sync, and client outcome records.
gates.remediation: Provision the target replica topology in staging and execute the documented failure matrix under the real supervisor and network policy.

gates.title: PostgreSQL never becomes silent financial authority after activation
gates.reason: FAIL for release: code and constraints contain no fallback route, but no activated staging cohort has proven this while TigerBeetle is unavailable and PostgreSQL remains reachable.
gates.requiredEvidence: An activated staging legal entity subjected to TigerBeetle outage, with proof that PostgreSQL journal/projection state never records financial acceptance as authority.
gates.remediation: Combine the outage rehearsal with database snapshots and rejected legacy-route calls before, during, and after the outage.

gates.title: Independent PostgreSQL and TigerBeetle backup/restore is proven
gates.reason: FAIL: PostgreSQL restored locally, but there is no independent TigerBeetle restore, non-empty shared cohort, matching restore boundary, or cross-store comparison.
gates.requiredEvidence: Independent PostgreSQL and TigerBeetle backups from the same frozen cohort, restoration to isolated endpoints, exact watermark selection, and zero unexplained mismatch.
gates.remediation: Define provider-supported TigerBeetle backup/restore operations, freeze posting, restore both stores independently, then run signed cross-store reconciliation.

gates.title: Recovery watermark is exact and auditable
gates.reason: FAIL for release: checkpoint structure, immutability, hashes, and comparisons exist, but watermark values are not yet collected from an independently restored pair of real stores.
gates.requiredEvidence: Store-derived source and target watermarks, snapshot references, checked timestamp, cohort identity, and signed exact-comparison output from restored staging data.
gates.remediation: Add trusted watermark collectors to the restore rehearsal and reject manually supplied production watermarks.

gates.title: Global reconciliation has zero unexplained mismatch
gates.reason: FAIL: reconciliation starts from PostgreSQL-known operation IDs and cannot discover an arbitrary provider-only TigerBeetle transfer; balance arrays are also incomplete for a global proof.
gates.requiredEvidence: A supported global transfer inventory or CDC cursor, complete account balances, orphan detection in both directions, deterministic hashes, and zero unexplained mismatch for the bounded cohort.
gates.remediation: Add an infrastructure-private TigerBeetle scan/CDC capability supported by the pinned version, feed it into checkpoint comparison, and test provider-only orphan detection.

gates.title: Projection and report rebuild is reproducible
gates.reason: FAIL for release: operation projections and outbox facts rebuild deterministically, but a complete independent balance/report/history rebuild has not run against restored production-equivalent data.
gates.requiredEvidence: A clean staging projection database rebuilt from authoritative facts, followed by deterministic report, balance, transfer-history, and hash comparison.
gates.remediation: Create the bounded first-profile report snapshot and run rebuild/comparison after independent restore.

gates.title: Verification artifacts remain immutable and cryptographically valid
gates.reason: PASS: canonical hashing is deterministic, Ed25519 signatures are verified, forged signatures are rejected, PostgreSQL blocks artifact mutation, and approval recomputes the persisted evidence hash. This gate covers artifact integrity only; production key custody is evaluated separately.
gates.requiredEvidence: The current repository tests and PostgreSQL constraint evidence are sufficient because this gate is a deterministic mechanical invariant.
gates.remediation: None for integrity semantics; retain regression tests when schemas, hashing, signatures, or immutability triggers change.

gates.title: Production-grade signing and key custody is proven
gates.reason: FAIL: the repository has a signer port and WebCrypto test implementation, but no selected production custody provider (KMS/HSM or an explicitly approved equivalent), production layer, custody proof, audit identity, access policy, or provider-outage rehearsal.
gates.requiredEvidence: Provider-specific custody-backed signing with key ID, non-exportability or an approved equivalent custody guarantee, workload identity, least-privilege policy, audit logs, and fail-closed outage behavior.
gates.remediation: Select the deployment custody policy, implement one approved signer in kernel infrastructure, wire it only in explicit production composition, and rehearse denied/unavailable operations.

gates.title: Key rotation and verification recovery is proven
gates.reason: PASS: signing and verification are separated; approval resolves the persisted signingKeyId through a historical keyring, and tests prove an old artifact remains approvable after the active signer rotates. Production custody and provider-specific rotation rehearsal remain separate gates.
gates.requiredEvidence: The repository test proving old-key verification after signer rotation is sufficient for the key-resolution contract.
gates.remediation: Keep historical public verifiers available according to retention policy; add provider revocation and emergency-recovery evidence when a KMS/HSM is selected.

gates.title: Critical failure conditions produce operator-visible alerts
gates.reason: FAIL: required metrics are documented, but no metrics exporter, versioned alert rules, notification route, delivery evidence, or operator acknowledgement is present.
gates.requiredEvidence: Metrics for unknown outcomes, accepted-unreconciled age, backlog, manual recovery, replica health, disk, and latency, plus fired-and-delivered alert records from injected failures.
gates.remediation: Choose the deployment observability backend, instrument the existing durable states, define alert rules and runbook links, then inject each critical failure in staging.

gates.title: Bounded production-equivalent cohort completes successfully
gates.reason: FAIL: no dedicated tenant/legal-entity cohort completed prepare, evidence collection, approval, activation, real posting, process restart, rebuild, restore, and reconciliation on production-equivalent infrastructure.
gates.requiredEvidence: A named owner, exact cohort, deployment revision, cluster identity, start/end timestamps, operation IDs, failure injections, SLO results, signed artifacts, and final zero-mismatch reconciliation.
gates.remediation: Provision a dedicated staging tenant and execute one controlled end-to-end rehearsal without enabling general production traffic.

gates.title: No unresolved P0 ledger, recovery, security, or operational blocker remains
gates.reason: FAIL: process-kill recovery, worker lease restart, quorum failure, paired restore, global reconciliation, production signing custody, operator alerts, and bounded cohort evidence remain unresolved.
gates.requiredEvidence: All other 15 gates must pass with their required evidence classes and have no open severity-P0 incident, mismatch, security exception, or ownerless remediation.
gates.remediation: Close gates 2, 3, 5, 7, 9, 12, 14, and 15 first; rerun the mechanical checker and obtain explicit release-owner approval.
